name: cockpit
description: Mods for Claude Code: guards that keep the agent out of trouble, and instruments that show where the session stands

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Installs every Cockpit mod at once: the usage-limit, memory, skill, loop, secret, collision and pipefail guards, the session panel, the HUD, the spinner status line and the task list.

plugins.name: usage-limit
plugins.description: Keeps the account usage limit from running out mid-task, with separate limits for the 5-hour and the 7-day windows: one subagent at a time (90% and 97%), a commit of the work in progress (97% and 98%), a pause that keeps the rest for you (98% and 99%), each one switchable, and an automatic resume when the window resets.

plugins.name: memory-guard
plugins.description: Keeps typecheck, build, test and Playwright runs under the memory limit, the tightest cgroup limit on Linux or the machine's memory on Linux, macOS and Windows: runs them with one process, waits for memory or refuses, and reruns a command killed with exit 137.

plugins.name: skill-loader
plugins.description: Loads the right skill at the right moment, so CLAUDE.md needs no load-this-skill rules: typescript-best-practices for .ts, writing-for-agents for SKILL.md, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, domain-modeling for CONTEXT.md and ADRs, technical-writing for READMEs, commits and PRs, and a diagnosing-bugs reminder when you paste an error.

plugins.name: loop-breaker
plugins.description: Notices when the agent goes in circles (repeated fix attempts on one file, the same error coming back, the same call repeated) and tells it to stop and change approach; refuses nothing.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Hides every secret value in tool output as <hidden:NAME> before the agent reads it, MCP and subagent output included, and writes the real value back when the agent puts the placeholder into a .env or secrets file.

plugins.name: pipefail
plugins.description: Adds set -o pipefail to a command that pipes a test, typecheck or lint run into tail, head or grep, so a failing run cannot exit 0 and read as a pass.

plugins.name: global-memory
plugins.description: Adds a machine-wide memory folder beside the per-project auto memory, so facts about the machine reach every session from any folder: rewrites the memory section for both folders and loads the global MEMORY.md.

plugins.name: todo
plugins.description: Keeps the native task list in front of the agent: the open tasks at session start and right after each compaction, a reminder that a new request becomes a task before any other work, completed tasks logged to an archive, and the app's task panel kept in line with the task files.

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: A heads-up display under or above the prompt: model, branch, context and plan limits, and memory headroom. /hud opens the full view

plugins.name: collision-guard
plugins.description: Warns when two Claude Code sessions on this machine edit the same file, and holds a git command once when it would stage, commit, stash or discard another session's uncommitted edits.

plugins.name: spinner-status
plugins.description: Replaces the tip under the spinner with one short line from Haiku: where this session stands, or a tip about your mods and their commands that fits the moment

plugins.name: panel
plugins.description: A local web page with a card for every Claude Code session on this machine: whether it waits for you, what it needs, what it is doing, with a summary from claude -p every few minutes and a refresh button.
